name: Advocata Institute (Sathya Karunarathne)
detail: Op-ed "Is wealth tax the solution to Sri Lanka's low tax revenue collection?" argues the 1958 wealth tax yielded little and a new one scores poorly on efficiency and feasibility.

name: Ravi Karunanayake (2015 mansion tax)
detail: Interim budget of January 2015: Rs 1 million a year on houses worth Rs 100 million or more. A high-value property tax.

name: Rajapaksa government super-rich tax (2013)
detail: Treasury officials weighed a super-rich tax for the 2014 budget; it was withdrawn under pressure. No named supporter, no design.

name: Thanuja Perera (Finance Ministry tax policy advisor)
detail: June 2024 quote describes the proposed wealth and property tax as an IMF benchmark; it explains the policy and does not argue for it.

name: Harsha de Silva (SJB)
detail: Spoke against the 2024 imputed rental income tax; no statement for a tax on net wealth found.

name: Unsigned columns in Daily FT (2022 windfall and wealth tax; Feb 2025 progressive taxation; May 2026 Stabilising inequality)
detail: Each argues for a wealth tax but names no author (an email address only), so there is no public figure to record. See leads.

name: Ranil Wickremesinghe, 18 June 2024 statement
detail: Called the imputed rental income tax on high-value property a wealth tax; the design taxes rental income from property, not net wealth.
